mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_comment (board_idx, user_email, comment_content, comment_date) VALUES (#{board.boardIdx}, #{userEmail}, #{commentContent}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_idx AS commentIdx , c.board_idx AS boardIdx , c.user_email AS userEmail , c.comment_content AS commentContent , c.comment_date AS commentDate , u.user_nickname AS userNickname FROM tb_comment c LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON c.user_email = u.user_email WHERE c.board_idx = #{boardIdx} ORDER BY c.comment_date ASC;
